card_text: Hard parts for Artesia: a shaved line that fills in fast, so time the trip to the day you need it.

seo.title: Hard Part for Artesia, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Hard part haircuts for Artesia, shaved in at my Carlsbad shop {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes south on US 285. When to book so the line is sharp for the day that matters.

paragraphs: A hard part is a part line shaved into the cut, so it stays exactly where I put it without a comb. The shop is in Carlsbad at {{address}}; from Artesia that's {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles down {{city:artesia.route}}, about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes each way (OpenStreetMap routing).
This is the one cut where timing the drive matters more than planning a cadence.

blocks.heading: Shaved lines don't wait.
paragraphs: A line taken to skin is the first thing on your head to fill back in; there's no hair above it to hide the regrowth. So if the part is for a wedding, a quinceañera, graduation photos or a first day somewhere, book your appointment as close to that date as the calendar allows. Spend the {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes on 285 a day or two before, not two weeks before.

blocks.heading: Line it up for the days off.
paragraphs: With {{city:artesia.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} of Artesia's jobs in mining, oil and gas, or agriculture (Census ACS 2023), a lot of weeks run on a rotation. If yours does, the same timing rule applies the other way around: get the part cut at the start of your days off, when people will actually see it, rather than the day before you go back out under a hard hat. By the next hitch it will have softened into the fade on its own.

blocks.heading: Hard part, from up the highway.

items.q: How far ahead of an event should I book a hard part from Artesia?
items.a: As close as you can get: the day before, or the morning of if there's a slot. The line is sharpest in its first few days.

items.q: Will the line look odd while it grows out?
items.a: It softens into the fade on its own. By the time you'd drive down again it's mostly gone, so you can decide fresh each visit.

items.q: Is a hard part an extra charge?
items.a: Text me a photo before you book and I'll tell you. A plain line may be part of the cut; more elaborate line work is the hair design add-on at {{addon:hair-design}}.

items.q: Can you put a hard part on a slick back or a crop?
items.a: Yes, either one. The hard part page shows a line cut straight through a high skin fade.

blocks.heading: The cut, plus the line.
blocks.lead: Prices and times straight from my Booksy menu.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Fade and top shaped to your head, neckline cleaned with a straight razor. The part goes in during the cut.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Same cut with your beard trimmed or lined up and a hot towel to finish.

items.title: Hair design add-on
items.body: For a line that curves, splits or joins others. Send me the photo first so we book the right thing.
